1. (Currently amended) A cooling system installable within a structure wall, comprising: in a housing, the housing disposed between a pair of studs of the wall __and protruding from the wall less than three inches__, a water reservoir; a pump; a pad; a water distributor; a motor; and a fan.

2. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the studs are spaced [[about]] __sixteen inches__ on center.

4. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the pump brings water from the water reservoir to the water distributor and the water distributor distributes the water to the pad thereby moistening the pad.

5. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 4, wherein the fan causes air to flow through the pad moistened by the water, thereby cooling the air by evaporation.

6. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 5, wherein the fan causes the cooled air to flow through an opening __in a front cover of the housing__.

7. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 4, wherein at least some of the water flows back to the reservoir for recirculation.

11. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the housing includes a front cover __having an opening through which the fan causes cooled air to flow__.

13. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the wall is a load-bearing wall __and the housing protrudes from the wall less than three inches__.

15. (Currently amended) A cooling system kit, comprising: the cooling system of claim 1; mounting elements; and a ventilation grill __for covering an opening in a front cover of the housing through which cooled air flows__.

17. (Currently amended) A cooling system, comprising: in a [[means for mounting within a structure wall, a means for evaporatively cooling an indoor area]] __housing configured for mounting within a structure wall between a pair of studs of the wall and protruding from the wall less than three inches, an evaporative cooler for cooling an indoor area, the evaporative cooler including a water reservoir, a pump, a pad, a water distributor, a motor, and a fan__.

18. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 17, wherein the [[means for mounting includes placing the means for evaporatively cooling]] __housing is configured to place the evaporative cooler__ between wall studs spaced [[about]] __sixteen inches__ on center.
